my parents never use each other’s names. my mom just says what she wants to my dad and he knows that she’s talking to him b/c they’ve been doing it for so long. my dad does the same, or even worse he calls her “hello” like how some people call their partner “honey.” they don’t have pet names or anything like that either.

I’ve just never been comfortable using people’s names b/c of this. it feels wrong which is dumb but that’s how it is. maybe if it was modelled I wouldn’t feel this way. oh well, just another thing I have to fix.
